quantity: minimum T-count of an ancilla-free Clifford+T (phase-polynomial) implementation of GF(2^n) multiplication |a,b,c> -> |a,b,c+ab>, i.e. the symmetric Waring rank over GF(2) of its signature tensor

sources.V25: V. Vandaele, Lower T-count with faster algorithms, Quantum 9, 1860 (2025), arXiv:2407.08695, Table 3
sources.ATQ: F. J. R. Ruiz et al., Quantum circuit optimization with AlphaTensor, Nat. Mach. Intell. (2025), arXiv:2402.14396; decompositions github.com/google-deepmind/alphatensor_quantum
sources.F26: D. Fisher, V. Khrulkov, M. Saygin, I. Oseledets, S. Straupe, LLM-Guided Evolutionary Search for Algebraic T-Count Optimization, arXiv:2603.29894 (2026), Table 1 (VarTODD+GigaEvo)

5.by: ATQ (decomposition released, verified); also Khoruzhii et al. and F26 K-branch. F26's 49 is excluded: its released matrix gf2^5_49.npy and its Vandaele start gf2^5_520.npy encode a bilinear map with zero divisors (12 of 31 nonzero a give a singular b -> a*b), so they are not GF(32) multiplication (results/published_values_audit.md)

not_comparable.WYWC26: H. Wang, M. Yu, X. Wu, J. Cong, Quantum Circuit Synthesis Using an Exact T Library, arXiv:2605.15476 (2026): out-of-place GF(2^n) multipliers with clean-ancilla don't-cares (a different unitary/cost model); values only in a bar chart

disputed.note: Published values whose released data do not decompose GF(2^n) multiplication, or that could not be checked. Bars below are kept (conservatively) except n=5.
disputed.F26_V_branch: Fisher et al. arXiv:2603.29894 Table I, Vandaele-start column: every released Vandaele start (n=3..16, 32) and final (n=5, 6, 9, 10, 11..16, 32) matrix encodes a map with zero divisors, i.e. not a field multiplication tensor in any basis. Affected Table I values include n=3: 27, 5: 49, 11: 215, 12: 243, 13: 293, 14: 319, 15: 363, 16: 383, 32: 1177; n=64: 3729 was not released. The Khoruzhii-start column (n=7..10) is correct where released.
disputed.V25_n3: Vandaele 2025 Table 3 'Ref.[61] & FastTODD' n=3: 23 - no circuit released; the public generator and optimizer give 31 T gates with 3 clean ancillas (in-place correct). Not refuted, not reproduced.
